claim: Let \(K\) be the six-vertex simplicial complex with facets \(012,013,024,035,045,125,134,145,234,235\), the minimal triangulation of \(\mathbb{RP}^2\). Exactly \(6396\) vertex maps \(K\to K\) are simplicial. Their contiguity classes are exactly one class of size \(6336\), containing every constant map and every non-automorphism, together with \(60\) singleton classes consisting precisely of the simplicial automorphisms. The large class is exactly the set of self-maps inducing zero on \(H_1(K;\mathbf F_2)\), while every automorphism induces the identity on this one-dimensional group.

integrity.finite_exhaustion: All \(46656\) vertex maps and all one-coordinate contiguity moves are checked by `verify.py`.
integrity.homology_check: Ranks over \(\mathbf F_2\) and an explicit cycle-cocycle pairing certify the one-dimensional \(H_1\) generator used for induced-map classification.
integrity.object_definition: The ten listed facets define the six-vertex closed surface of Euler characteristic one.

scientific_limitations: The census concerns direct simplicial self-maps of the fixed six-vertex triangulation, not maps after subdivision.
Contiguity is stricter than ordinary homotopy, so the 61 classes are not asserted to be ordinary homotopy classes.
Targeted search cannot exclude an obscure prior computation of the same exact endomorphism and contiguity census.
title: Contiguity census of the minimal six-vertex projective plane
